newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed, 18-mo debut.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed, 18-mo debut.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six- and nine-month treasury bills rose and 12-month yields were unchanged from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The statement also gave details of the first auction of discount 18-month T-bills, whose yields stood at 32.47 percent.
Six-month bills rose to 20.22 percent from 20.15 percent, nine-month yields firmed to 28.16 percent from 28.14 percent, and 12-month bills remained at 30.46 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.63 million UAH 13.63 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 26.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 73.50 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 73.50 million UAH 163.47 million UAH
Actual amount raised 60.71 million UAH 135.03 million UAH
The central bank sold 735,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 26.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 130.68 million UAH 203.43 million UAH
Actual amount raised 100.23 million UAH 156.03 million UAH

The central bank sold 1,306,835 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 26. The results of the first 18-month T-bill auction were as follows:
The central bank sold 888,267 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of discount 18-month T-bills is is scheduled for June 26.
